fields.name: url
fields.label: Music Assistant server address
fields.hint: The base URL of your Music Assistant server, including the port (default 8095). Find it in the Music Assistant frontend under Settings > General, or in the Home Assistant Music Assistant integration's device info.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Music Assistant API token
fields.hint: Create one in the Music Assistant web UI under Settings > Users. Required by Music Assistant 2.11 and later; leave blank for older, unauthenticated servers.
